hints: Observe the change in horizontal coordinates of key vertices from $f(x)$ to $g(x)$ to determine the horizontal scale factor.
Observe the vertical displacement of the graph to find the translation vector.
State both transformations fully using standard mathematical descriptions (type, scale factor/direction, vector).
walkthrough:
Observe the horizontal stretching of the graph from $y = f(x)$ to $y = g(x)$:
$$\text{The horizontal width of corresponding segments is doubled, representing a stretch parallel to the } x\text{-axis with scale factor } 2$$

Observe the vertical displacement of the entire graph:
$$\text{The graph is shifted downward by } 2 \text{ units, which is a translation by the vector } \begin{pmatrix} 0 \\ -2 \end{pmatrix}$$

State the complete sequence of two transformations:
$$1.\ \text{Stretch with scale factor } 2 \text{ parallel to the } x\text{-axis (or in the } x\text{-direction)}$$
$$2.\ \text{Translation by vector } \begin{pmatrix} 0 \\ -2 \end{pmatrix} \text{ (or } 2 \text{ units vertically downwards)}$$
$$\text{(Note: These transformations may be performed in either order.)}$$
